position_interpolation: linear only for identities alive at both endpoints; all others held
topology_interpolation: native segments and node activity at latest saved frame
faces: recorded table faces whose vertices all belong to the crop; all active at every sample

face_selection.rule: keep whole native membrane triangles below +0.075 um along the patch normal and within 45.6 degrees of its tangent plane at every sample; steep microvillus side faces are omitted

relations_reason: This record saves kinetic relation states only every 25 steps

crop.anchor_rule: Membrane radius in the most populated 1 um bin of projected microvilli at the final frame
crop.sampling: all selected identities; no within-patch subsampling

movement_definition: Euclidean source-coordinate measurements for identities alive throughout; no rigid-body subtraction; bbox is axis-aligned trajectory extent, not amplitude
evidence: Archived 310 K smaller-cell preview; FORCE-ACCEPTED (10 Newton per step). Not a balanced physical trajectory or a comparison with cell measurements.
display_note: Fixed spatial crop, transparent illustrative Studio materials. Geometry outside the crop and kinetic attachments are omitted. Line-width cap is a display setting.
